description: This file contains the main activity implementation for an Android Tic-Tac-Toe game, including UI setup, game logic, interactions, and animations.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity class managing the game UI, mechanics, and animations for Tic-Tac-Toe.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, and configures event listeners.

methods.name: setupBoard
methods.description: Initializes or resets the game board UI and internal state.

methods.name: updateTurnDisplay
methods.description: Updates the UI to show which player's turn it is.

methods.name: resetBoard
methods.description: Clears the game board and resets game state to start a new game.

methods.name: newGame
methods.description: Starts a fresh game by resetting the internal state and UI.

methods.name: switchPlayer
methods.description: Switches the current player from 'X' to 'O' or vice versa.

methods.name: checkWin
methods.description: Checks if the current player has won the game.

methods.name: isDraw
methods.description: Checks if the game has resulted in a draw.

methods.name: aiMove
methods.description: Performs a simple AI move by selecting the first available cell.

methods.name: animateButton3DRotate
methods.description: Applies a 3D flip animation to a button and executes a callback after the animation.
